result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: an invalid '€NaN delivery' price label on the Smash Bros Burgers restaurant card.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card under 'Fastest near you' shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the price data formatting / fallback logic to display the correct delivery fee or hide the fee line when the value is unavailable.
